versions.changelog:
- 新增 tools/generate_copy.js 文件，添加文案生成工具函数
- 为功能扩展打下基础，便于后续集成和调用

Initial release of copywriting-generator.

- AI-powered tool for marketing copy creation, title generation, CTA design, and A/B test suggestions.
- Supports multiple content styles and platforms (Xiaohongshu, Douyin, Taobao, WeChat, etc.).
- Provides copywriting optimization suggestions and style adaptation.
- Free and paid user tiers available for different needs.
- Targets e-commerce sellers, content creators, brands, agencies, and social media managers.
